subject: Co-hosted webinar with CloudForge — asset sync, tracking map & RSVP cadence
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-02-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed invite + ask: CloudForge co-host (Feb webinar)

Hey team —

Following the CloudForge call yesterday, they confirmed interest in co-hosting a February webinar focused on inference cost optimization for platform teams. I put together a first-draft invite and a short list of assets we'll need from them to co-promote. Please review and flag any missing asks.

Quick summary:
- Target audience: platform engineers, infra leads, SREs at mid-market/enterprise companies
- Goal: drive 800-1,200 registrants with 30% trial/activation lift for Redwood-specific CTAs
- High-level CTA: Register for webinar + opt-in for a 2-week joint trial (promo code)

Draft invite attached: draft_invite_v1.docx (subject line proposals, three intro variants, 2CTA buttons).
Assets requested from CloudForge: logo (SVG), hero slide, 1 pager, co-branded social copy.

Open questions:
1) Tracking: do we want HubSpot campaign + partner utm_source param or unique microsite?
2) RSVP reminders: cadence (3-touch: initial, 3 days, 24 hours) or 4-touch including day-of?
3) Promo code logistics: who owns code creation and redemption metrics?

Action items:
- Marcus: can you map tracking/UTM template for HubSpot?
- Logan: can you confirm registration page URL & whether we can accept a partner-limited promo code?
- Stephanie: ping CloudForge for assets and request a final logo by EOD Mon.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-02-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed invite + ask: CloudForge co-host (Feb webinar)

Thanks Camila — solid start. A few notes on tracking and the registration experience:

1) Tracking: HubSpot campaign + query params on the registration page is our preferred approach for partner co-hosts. Proposed UTM scheme: utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26, utm_source=cloudforge, utm_medium=email, partner_code=CFRED10. I'll need the final campaign name to create analytics dashboards.

2) Registration page: we can host on our registration endpoint and append the partner params. Link will be the Zoom registration with our redirect: https://redwood.zoom.us/meeting/register/abc-123-cohost?utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26&utm_source=cloudforge

3) Promo code: we have to create it in our billing backend; Marcus, can you confirm the promo redemption flow and whether we can attribute activations to the code? I recommend the 2-week joint trial gated behind a promo code so we can track partner-driven activations.

4) RSVP cadence: +1 on 3-touch (initial, 3 days, 24 hours). Add a calendar invite in the registration confirmation email.

Camila — can you share the draft invite content inline in the next reply so I can suggest copy edits quickly? Also assign the HubSpot campaign ID if possible (I can create once we lock the name).

Thanks — Logan

--
Logan Wright
Partnerships, Events Lead | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Anna Li <anna@cloudforge.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: marketing@cloudforge.io
Date: 2026-02-04T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed invite + ask: CloudForge co-host (Feb webinar)

Hi Camila/Logan —

Great to be moving forward. Attaching our asset package (CloudForge_Assets.zip) which includes logos, a 1-pager, and a hero slide. We can provide short social snippets and an approved blurb for the invite.

On the promo code: we can confirm CFRED10 as the partner promo code and we will track redemptions on our side as well. We expect legal to sign off on a simple co-promo agreement — our marketing ops can share the draft.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Please include a co-branded registration confirmation and a single-count tracking pixel for CloudForge (we'll provide the pixel snippet separately).
- Can we get the final invite copy by EOD Friday so our upstream comms can schedule partner newsletter sends?

We're good with the 3-touch RSVP cadence. If possible we also prefer a short reminder ~90 minutes prior for highly engaged prospects.

Attaching: CloudForge_Assets.zip

Best,
Anna
Partnerships | CloudForge
anna@cloudforge.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-04T10:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed invite + ask: CloudForge co-host (Feb webinar)

Thanks — I can own the tracking side. Quick plan:
- HubSpot campaign id: will create once we finalize campaign name (proposing CF_Redwood_Feb26).
- UTM mapping (examples):
  * Email: utm_medium=email, utm_source=cloudforge, utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26
  * Social: utm_medium=social, utm_source=cloudforge, utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26
  * Partner newsletter: utm_medium=newsletter, utm_source=cloudforge, utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26
- Promo attribution: we'll set partner_code as a custom contact property in HubSpot so we can build a report that attributes trial activations to CFRED10.

I added a small appendix in the (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) with the event timestamps and who owns each asset — will attach final after Logan confirms the registration URL and campaign name.

Marcus
Growth Analytics | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna@cloudforge.io>, marketing@cloudforge.io
Date: 2026-02-05T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed invite + ask: CloudForge co-host (Feb webinar)

All —

Closing the loop with final itemization and next steps before I share to execs and ops: please treat this as the mutual action plan for the next 72 hours.

Final decisions:
- Registration URL (hosted by Redwood + Zoom): https://redwood.zoom.us/meeting/register/abc-123-cohost?utm_campaign=CF_Redwood_Feb26&utm_source=cloudforge&utm_medium=email
- HubSpot campaign: CF_Redwood_Feb26 (Marcus to create campaign id: HS-2026-1387)
- Promo code: CFRED10 (2-week trial, created by Redwood billing, Marcus to flag in report)
- RSVP cadence: Initial invite, 3-day reminder, 24-hour reminder, day-of 90-minute nudge.

Deliverables and owners (attached in mutual_action_plan.xlsx):
- Camila: finalize invite copy & delivery schedule (deadline: 2026-02-06 11:00 PST)
- CloudForge (Anna): provide final hero slide + social snippets (deadline: 2026-02-06 11:00 PST)
- Marcus: create HubSpot campaign & reporting dashboard (deadline: 2026-02-06 14:00 PST)
- Logan: create registration link and set promo in billing (in progress)

Links: registration (above), campaign (https://hubspot.example.com/campaigns/CF-REDWOOD-2026), shared assets (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CoHostAssets)

Camila — once the invite copy is final, I'll forward to ops for scheduling and CC legal on the co-promo terms.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this live.

--
Logan Wright
Partnerships, Events Lead | Redwood Inference
